Lemon Squeezy is no longer accepting new sign-ups and will shut down on March 31, 2027
Before selling any products, you will need to enable live mode for your store by activating your store in two steps.
When you first sign up for Lemon Squeezy, your store will be in
. Before selling any products, you will need to enable live mode for your store. You can do this by clicking the “
There are two steps to the activation process:
Fill in a short questionnaire about your business and customers
Once submitted, approvals typically happen in 2-3 business days. We recommend you answer the questions honestly and provide as much information as possible.

When you create products in test mode, they will not automatically be available in live mode when your store is activated. However, it’s easy to copy test mode products and discounts to live mode using the “Copy to Live Mode” item in the product or discount menu.
Why do I have to activate my store?
One of the biggest benefits of using Lemon Squeezy, is we act as the

on your behalf. This is important when selling digital products, software/SaaS, online courses, etc. It’s easy to go cross-border with your payments, and before you know it, you are stuck worrying about tax compliance, fraud, and much more.

Lemon Squeezy takes care of all those headaches for you as the merchant of record. For this reason, Lemon Squeezy reviews every store to run KYC & KYB checks to ensure the validity of your business and that the products you’re selling are aligned with our
What types of stores do you approve?
We approve most stores selling digital goods that can be fulfilled by Lemon Squeezy (e.g. eBooks, PDFs, design assets, photos, audio, video, etc.) as long as they are not

We typically do not approve stores selling services or goods fulfilled outside of Lemon Squeezy (e.g. physical goods, design services, rentals, access to private telegram groups, etc). However, there are some exceptions to this rule. Businesses using subscriptions and/or license keys to manage fulfilment (e.g. SaaS/software companies, premium courses, membership sites, etc.) are typically allowed.
What is the wait time for new applications?
Thank you for submitting your application!

We appreciate your interest in using Lemon Squeezy where we power payments for thousands of software companies globally. Our team is dedicated to reviewing your application carefully to ensure we understand the nature of your business and what you’re selling. While we strive to complete this quickly, the time can vary. Rest assured, we are working diligently to get back to you soon.
Thank you for your patience and understanding. We look forward to being a part of your journey!
What countries does Lemon Squeezy support?

At Lemon Squeezy, we are committed to expanding our reach and continuously adding support for new countries. If your country is not on our list, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Your feedback is valuable, and it helps us prioritize and track the demand for support in different regions.
Thank you for your interest and for helping us grow our global community!
What if my application is not approved?

We understand that receiving a notification that your application was not approved can be disappointing. Our application process is rigorous, as we carefully consider many factors to ensure compliance, support for different countries, and compatibility with the types of businesses and products we support.

However, this decision is not the end of the road. If you believe there was a mistake or if there have been changes to your business that might address any issues, we encourage you to resubmit your application. We value your interest and are here to support you throughout this process.
Thank you for your understanding and patience. We look forward to the possibility of working with you in the future.
Why is my application still pending?
We understand that waiting for an application decision can be challenging, and we want to keep you informed. Your application may remain in a pending state for a couple of reasons:
Due to the popularity of our services, we may experience a high volume of applications. Rest assured, our team is working diligently to review and process each application as quickly as possible.

As part of our thorough review process, we conduct a comprehensive risk assessment for each application. This helps ensure the safety and security of our platform and community. While this step can sometimes extend the review period, it is essential to maintaining our high standards.

Our platform supports a wide range of products and services. However, some applications may stay pending with the potential of being denied if they fall outside our current scope of supported products. We are continuously working to expand our capabilities and welcome your feedback. If your product is not currently supported, please reach out to us. Your input helps us prioritize future updates and enhancements.
